findings.summary: Writer carrier compares two immediate serializations of the same object and verifies extraction, but does not directly inspect the fixed header metadata or permute source entry order. Likewise the empty-directory reader assertion checks existence only (line 101). These are assertion-depth concerns, not missing carriers; no executed counterexample, so coverage stays pass under REV-4/REV-5.

New tar fixtures carry an empty replay closure; nonempty replay integrity is exercised only through the existing v3 restore suite. Consider a tar round-trip of a real existing replay fixture when implementing the envelope mapping. No executed wrong-implementation artifact; advisory under REV-5.

Corrected byte-cap citation exercises the shared owner with a small limit and the snapshot wrapper's fetch-stage errors; it does not directly execute a snapshot decompression-stage failure. The unchanged shared owner is real and its five tests passed. Wrapper-specific decompression proof is advisory at this Contract+RED checkpoint without an executed counterexample.
